from pathlib import Path

original = p.read_bytes()

'Subhe ashur hai': 'Subh-e-Aashur hai',
'Subhe ashur hai...': 'Subh-e-Aashur hai...',
'Dede akbar azaṅ': 'De de Akbar azaaṅ',
'Mere nawjawaṅ': 'Mere naujawaaṅ',
'De aisi azaṅ': 'De aisi azaaṅ',
'Jo pahunche jina': 'Jo pahunche jinaaṅ',
'Rahe taa jahaṅ': 'Rahe taa jahaaṅ',
'Jaane baba': 'Jaan-e-baaba',
'Shabihe nabi': 'Shabih-e-Nabi',
'Yahaṅ hai tu hi': 'Yahaaṅ hai tu hi',
'Sare karbala': 'Sar-e-Karbala',
'Dil e ghamzada': 'Dil-e-ghamzada',
'Mere beta': 'Mere betaa',
'Jo dekha yahaṅ': 'Jo dekha yahaaṅ',
'Behan nauhagar': 'Behan nauha gar',
'Musalle pe maa': 'Musalle pe maaṅ',
'Boli fizza': 'Boli Fizza',
'Azaṅ ho to yuṅ': 'Azaaṅ ho to yuṅ',
'Hare ek lafz meiṅ': 'Hare ak lafz meiṅ',
'Nazar aaye khuṅ': 'Nazar aaye khuṅ',
'Mere jadd ka': 'Mere jad ka',
'Azaṅ meiṅ asar': 'Azaaṅ meiṅ asar',
'Sun le sughra': 'Sun le Sughra',
'Abhi hai yahaṅ': 'Abhi hai yahaaṅ',
'Mere naujawan': 'Mere jawaaṅ',
'Sunenge azaṅ': 'Suneṅ ge azaaṅ',
'Mere nana jaaṅ': 'Mere naanaa jaaṅ',
'Tere dada': 'Tere daadaa',
'Azaṅ bete ki': 'Azaaṅ bete ki',
'Jo mazhar suni': 'Jo Mazhar suni',
'Yehi us ghari': 'Yahi us ghari',
'Shukre maula': 'Shukr-e-Maula',
}
lines = [replacements.get(line.strip(), line.strip()) for line in roman.splitlines()]
index = lines.index('Azaaṅ meiṅ asar')
assert lines[index-2] == 'Ae shabih-e-Mustafa'
lines[index-2] = 'Ae Shabbir Mustafa'
assert len(lines) == len(source.strip().splitlines())
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in '\\n'.join(lines))
updated = (metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line for line in lines) + '\\n---\\n' + source).encode()
assert updated.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
p.write_bytes(updated)
PY"

item.text:
Audited every Roman verse against the Urdu in [subhe-ashur-hai.md](src/data/lyrics/subhe-ashur-hai.md). Corrected vowel lengths, nasal endings, izafat, and wording mismatches, including `Ae Shabbir Mustafa` and `Mere jawaaṅ` where those readings appear in the source.

Verified line-by-line alignment and preserved the Urdu body byte for byte. Metadata and stanza structure were preserved. The unusual source reading `ہرے اک` remains visible as `Hare ak` for editorial review.
